items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And I can remember Sy Shribman, when Miller made his, you know, was up, Shribman told Glenn he says, “That’s a lot of money, isn’t it Glenn?”

ctx.x: And I can remember Sy Shribman, when Miller made his, you know, was up, Shribman told Glenn he says, “That’s a lot of money, isn’t it Glenn?” You know he had a gravely voice. He says, “Well I’m going to let you out of that.” And he did. He let him off the hook.
That was pretty gentlemanly of him.
